items.title: Bhotekoshi flood: Affected children to receive Rs 17,500 in monthly assistance
items.summary: Rasuwa, November 27 The government has launched a long-term protection and care programme for children affected by the Bhotekoshi floods, beginning in Goljungbesi of Ward 5 of Aamachhodingmo Rural Municipality in Rasuwa. items.title: DNA matches offer hope to Rasuwa flood victims’ families, but body identification remains incomplete
items.summary: Kathmandu, November 26 Three months after the devastating Bhotekoshi flood in Rasuwa, families of those who went missing are still waiting to receive their loved ones’ remains. DNA test results have offered some hope to families searching for missing relatives, but a DNA match alone is not enough to release a body. items.title: Where the August floods began
items.summary: A massive ice and rock avalanche from Langtang Lirung plunged into the Lhende river on August 26, triggering devastating floods that swept through Rasuwa, Nuwakot and Dhading.
